entities.name: Björn Phau
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Björn Phau is a retired German tennis player. He achieved a career-high singles ranking of World No. 59 in June 2006. Career highlights include reaching five ATP tour semifinals and finishing runner-up in doubles at Munich in 2006.
